name: Increasing a load's energy re-solves the schedule

planSteps.description: Open the app and wait for the initial solve to finish.
Record the EV charger's energy figure, its slot count, and the saving figure in the Outcome section.
Press '+' on the EV charger once and wait for the app to finish re-solving.
Verify the EV charger's energy figure has risen by exactly 0.5 kWh from the value you recorded.
Verify the saving figure or the scheduled bill total has changed from the value you recorded, proving the schedule was recomputed rather than left stale on screen.
Press '-' once and wait for the re-solve.
Verify the energy figure has returned to the value you first recorded.
